summary: 2026-11-25 to 11-26: GLM-5.4 CONFIRMED from primary sources (official Z.ai developer docs docs.z.ai/guides/llm/glm-5.4, updated 2026-11-23) and recorded - Z.ai flagship first built on a Loop Transformer: 28 layers of the 750B-scale GLM-5 base run for 2 iterations with gated progressive updates, hybrid KV cache (cross-loop sparse KV sharing plus an independent sliding window for the second pass) and sparse attention index reuse, 1M context, thinking mode, available to all GLM Coding Plan users (weekly quota 1.5x GLM-5.3), up to 200 tokens/s off-peak and 70-80 tokens/s at peak (vendor figures), known limitation of marathon thinking loops; no public API or open weights confirmed in the official docs. Previous run (2026-11-25) could not confirm it from primary sources; the official docs page now establishes it. llama.cpp dev builds b12683-b12703 (b12686 server fix for skipped prompt cache lookups moving the lookup into the slot scheduler, b12683 rpc reusing one context for request tensors on the server, b12690 HIP MMQ over MMVQ for Q4_K N8 and NVFP4 N7-8 on VEGA20, b12703 CUDA kernel fusing RMS_NORM/MUL and MROPE/IMROPE with automatic block-size tuning; no speed multipliers published). No new release in window: vLLM v0.34.0, SGLang v0.5.23, TensorRT-LLM v1.3.0, LMDeploy v0.18.0, Ollama v0.40.18 remain latest; DeepSpeed and HF Transformers had no new release above the patch threshold already treated as below recording level (v0.20.1 / v5.24.1 of 2026-11-24). All other LLM series (Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma, Llama, Mistral, Nemotron, Kimi, MiniMax, Phi, GPT): no primary-confirmed important updates in window. Direct-apply per skill section 9 (Phase 1).
